source: Formulas.calcMagicDam(attacker, target, skill, shld, sps, bss, mcrit)
note: result = damage (double, before the (int) cast of the MagicalDamage effect). shots: sps / bss are the booleans passed to the function. mcrit is the passed flag (calcMCrit is in skill_formulas_mcrit.json). With MagicFailures on, calcMagicSuccess draws first (Rnd.get(100) < rate = success); on failure a player attacker draws a second calcMagicSuccess (half damage when it succeeds and the level difference is <= 9, else damage 1), then the weapon random multiplier draws (RandomizeMagicalSkillDamage). shld 2 returns 1 before any draw. intermediate: the numbers the function reads from the pair. Every case has 'script' (the unit values u in [0,1) that were consumed) and 'rnd' (every Rnd call in order: method, bound, returned value; get_int bound b returns floor(u*b), get_int_range o,b returns o+floor(u*(b-o+1)), nextGaussian is 2u-1 in the harness). Calls that draw nothing are not recorded. Replay the returned values in order and check method and bound.
